Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store

Class ConceptMapStaging

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store.ConceptMapStaging
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class ConceptMapStaging extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The transient staging of the ConceptMaps of an import streamed to disk: an NDJSON file with one line per mapping and another with one line per group, written by the flattener and read back through Spark, so the driver never holds the mappings or the groups of a map in memory. Every ConceptMap of an import is staged into the same files, each row carrying the identifier of the map it belongs to, so the importer writes the mapping table once for the whole import. Each mapping refers to its group by index within its map, because a group's systems may follow its elements in the source. The files live in a driver-local temporary directory that is deleted when the staging is closed. The one thing held in memory is the first fault recorded for the current map, the reason it cannot be read as a concept map relation, which the importer collects for the manifest before the next map begins.
Author:
John Grimes

    • appendMapping

      public void appendMapping(int group, @Nonnull String sourceCode, @Nullable String sourceDisplay, @Nullable String targetCode, @Nullable String targetDisplay, @Nonnull String equivalence)
      Appends a mapping row, numbering it with its position in document order.
      Parameters:
      group - the index of the group the mapping belongs to
      sourceCode - the code of the source concept
      sourceDisplay - the display of the source element, or null where it gives none
      targetCode - the code of the target concept, or null where the target carries none
      targetDisplay - the display of the target, or null where it gives none
      equivalence - the equivalence code of the mapping
      Throws:
      TerminologyImportException - if the map holds more mappings than can be numbered
